insights.headline: Gold stalls near $4,055 as Saudi refinery attack claims lift oil ahead of tonight's Fed decision
insights.summary: Gold gave back part of Tuesday's recovery in early US trading, holding near $4,054.60 an ounce, after claims of a strike on Saudi Arabia's largest refinery pushed Brent crude above $115 and revived worries that oil-driven inflation could keep the Fed hawkish. Spot silver slipped to about $54.20, near its 11-month low. The Fed announces its decision at 18:00 GMT, with rates widely expected to stay unchanged and traders pricing about an 84% chance of a December hike. On the MCX, December gold eased to ₹1,43,492 per 10 grams on weak spot demand as jewellers delayed purchases ahead of Dhanteras.
points: Gold traded near $4,054.60 in early US trade, down 0.16%, after giving back part of Tuesday's recovery.
Brent crude rose above $115 after claims of a missile strike on Saudi Arabia's largest refinery.
Silver slipped 0.40% to about $54.20 an ounce, still close to its 11-month low.
The Fed announces at 18:00 GMT; rates are widely expected to hold, with an ~84% chance of a December hike priced.
MCX December gold eased to ₹1,43,492 per 10 grams on weak spot demand; silver held near ₹1.92 lakh per kg.

trending.title: Oil shock puts Fed day on edge
trending.summary: Claims of a strike on Saudi Arabia's largest refinery pushed Brent above $115, stalling gold's recovery hours before the Fed's 18:00 GMT decision.

trending.title: Silver slides toward 11-month lows
trending.summary: Silver slipped to about $54.20 while MCX silver futures held near ₹1.92 lakh per kg, with ETFs also under pressure from their highs.

trending.title: Dhanteras buyers wait for a dip
trending.summary: Indian jewellers are holding off purchases, betting prices will fall, even as MCX gold eased to ₹1,43,492 per 10 grams.

trending.title: Policy: hallmarking widened, SGB price set
trending.summary: BIS extended mandatory gold hallmarking to 12 more districts and the RBI set an early redemption price for a 2020-21 sovereign gold bond series.

items.title: Gold recovery stalls as Saudi refinery attack claims lift crude, silver retreats - Kitco AM Report
items.summary: Gold gave back part of Tuesday's recovery as claims of a strike on Saudi Arabia's largest refinery pushed crude higher, reviving worries that oil-led inflation could keep the Fed hawkish. Spot gold traded near $4,054.60, down 0.16%; silver slipped 0.40% to about $54.20. Traders still expect a Fed hold on Wednesday, with an ~84% chance of a December hike priced in.

items.title: US Fed rate decision today: What investors should watch in gold, silver prices and market outlook
items.summary: Gold and silver edged lower as investors awaited the Fed decision due at 11:30 pm IST, with rates widely expected to stay unchanged and attention on clues about a December hike. September CPI at 3.7% and core at 2.6% remain above the Fed's 2% target, keeping the dollar firm. MCX December gold futures eased 0.15% to ₹1,43,925 per 10 grams and silver futures fell nearly ₹2,000 per kg to ₹1,94,848.

items.title: Gold futures decline to ₹1.43 lakh/10 gram on weak spot demand
items.summary: Gold futures on the MCX fell ₹646, or 0.45%, to ₹1,43,492 per 10 grams for December delivery on Wednesday as weaker spot demand weighed, in a turnover of 699 lots. Globally, gold futures declined 0.72% to $4,030.95 an ounce in New York.

items.title: India jewellers hold off gold buying, betting prices will drop
items.summary: Indian jewellers are holding back on gold purchases ahead of the festive season's busiest stretch, betting that the recent price slide has further to run, according to the country's biggest precious metals refiner. The caution comes even as Dhanteras and Diwali approach, with the trade expecting cheaper prices ahead.

items.title: Gold Traders Weigh Asian Buying Against a Hawkish Fed and Firmer Dollar
items.summary: Bullion is caught between a firmer dollar, elevated yields and oil-led inflation worries on one side, and central-bank buying plus Asian retail demand on the other. Gold settled near $4,048.47 an ounce. With the Fed's decision due later on Wednesday and rates widely expected to hold, guidance on the policy path is the focal point.

items.title: Gold (XAUUSD) & Silver Price Forecast: Oil Rebound Revives Hike Fears, Can Gold Hold $4,015?
items.summary: Gold gave back part of Tuesday's gain on Wednesday as rebounding crude revived inflation worries ahead of the Fed decision, FXEmpire reports, with spot gold near $4,035 after stalling near $4,039. Support sits at $4,015, then $3,975, with resistance at $4,039, $4,059 and $4,079. Silver traded near $53.96, with $54.46 the first resistance and $52.41 the first support.

items.title: Commodity Corner: Oil rises on Iran tensions; gold holds above $4,000 ahead of Fed decision
items.summary: Oil climbed as Middle East tensions flared, with Brent crude moving toward $116 a barrel, while gold held above $4,000 an ounce on dip-buying ahead of the Federal Reserve's decision later on Wednesday. Silver was little changed at $54.41 an ounce, and the dollar was mixed as traders also awaited the Bank of Canada's decision.

items.title: Elevated oil prices keep up heat on rupee, traders await cues from Fed
items.summary: Elevated crude oil prices kept pressure on the rupee on Wednesday, with traders cautious ahead of the Federal Reserve's policy decision later in the day. The Fed's guidance is being watched for cues on the dollar and interest rates, which in turn feed into domestic bullion prices.

items.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD falls to near $54.00 due to higher oil prices
items.summary: Silver slipped back toward $54 an ounce in Asian trading on Wednesday after a modest rebound, as rising crude prices, lifted by Israel's tight election outcome, revived inflation worries ahead of the Federal Reserve's decision later in the day. Markets priced a roughly 93% chance the Fed holds rates at 3.75-4.00%, with traders watching Chair Warsh's remarks for clues on a December move.

items.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD drops as oil price rebounds, Fed's policy eyed
items.summary: Gold slipped 0.3% to near $4,050 in Asian trade on Wednesday as oil prices bounced back after a two-day correction, with WTI near $100.50. FXStreet notes the metal faces high volatility ahead of the Federal Reserve's policy announcement at 18:00 GMT, with a firmer dollar and Treasury yields back above 5% also weighing.

items.title: Gold chart update: Is $4,000 once again acting as a floor?
items.summary: Gold briefly slipped below $4,000 an ounce in recent days but closed back above it at $4,016, with the summer lows still intact. The analysis puts the stochastic oscillator and RSI near buy-signal territory, suggesting the metal could attempt a fresh upward move.

items.title: Downside risks are building in gold, but prices still have a path to $5,000 - State Street's Doshi
items.summary: State Street still sees gold reaching $4,750–$5,500 an ounce by the end of Q1 2027, but has cut the odds of that scenario to 60% from 70% as inflation, rising bond yields and a hawkish Fed cloud the outlook. Its bearish case, given 35% odds, keeps gold between $4,000 and $4,750 for six to nine months.

items.title: Silver At 11-Month Low: What's Behind The Precious Metal's Dramatic Reversal?
items.summary: Silver has fallen more than 53% from its January record near $117 an ounce to just above $53, as a stronger dollar, yields near 5% and tighter Fed expectations outweigh safe-haven support from Middle East tensions, analysts say. On MCX, silver fell from Rs 3,79,983 per kg in January to Rs 1,94,170 on October 23. Analysts flag $50 as the next key support.

items.title: Strong dollar, high yields drag on gold outlook, but central-bank demand lends support
items.summary: Analysts trimmed their 2026 gold price forecast in a Reuters survey of 30 analysts and traders, citing high Treasury yields, a strong dollar and rates staying high for longer. The median 2026 forecast is $4,495 an ounce, down from $4,509, while the 2027 median rose to $4,650. Central-bank buying and demand from India and China are expected to support prices.

items.title: Gold Fights Back. Silver Breaks Lower. Same Dollar, Different Stories.
items.summary: Gold reclaimed a falling-wedge boundary after Monday's close above it, retesting the breakout near $4,001.80 before rebounding toward $4,045.10, FXEmpire reports, though the $4,042-$4,060 zone, Friday's bearish gap plus a new declining channel, now stands in the way. Silver, by contrast, fell to another local low despite the stronger-dollar backdrop, underscoring the split between the metals.

items.title: Silver Falls, Gold Rallies as China Retail Investing Jumps, ETFs Sell
items.summary: Silver hit an 11-month low of $52.68 an ounce in Asian trade Tuesday while gold rallied from 3-month lows, fixing at $3,997 in London before rising to $4,030. Retail gold investment demand in China is surging, led by households buying investment gold, while Western gold ETFs saw their first weekly liquidation in a month. The gold/silver ratio rose to 74.3, its highest since November last year.

items.title: Silver futures decline to ₹1.92 lakh/kg
items.summary: Silver futures fell ₹3,743, or 1.91%, to ₹1,92,050 per kg on the MCX on Tuesday as participants cut bets, in a turnover of 3,482 lots. In New York, silver traded 2.14% lower at $52.81 an ounce.

items.title: Gold Prices Crash Over Rs 3,000 In 10 Days, Fall Near Rs 1.42 Lakh As US Fed Decision Nears
items.summary: MCX gold futures for December delivery fell to an intraday low of ₹1,42,216 per 10 grams on October 27, trading at ₹1,42,460 around 1:09 p.m., down ₹613 or 0.43%. The contract has fallen ₹3,632 from its October 14 close of ₹1,45,848 as traders positioned ahead of the US Federal Reserve's decision.

items.title: Gold loan stress rising: How to avoid a debt trap and manage repayments
items.summary: Repayment stress on gold loans is rising, Business Standard reports: Bajaj Finance has flagged delays, and Piramal Finance has raised concerns about lending to borrowers overdue elsewhere. Under an RBI rule in force since April 1, 2026, bullet gold loans for consumption are capped at 12 months, with accrued interest to be cleared before renewal or pledged gold could face auction.

items.title: Gold, Silver ETFs sink up to 53% from 52-week highs; Silver at 11-month low
items.summary: Silver ETFs have crashed up to 53% from their 52-week highs hit in January 2026, while gold ETFs have declined up to 26%. DSP Silver ETF traded at ₹18.17, down 53.4% from its 52-week high of ₹39 on January 29, 2026, as spot silver hovered near 11-month lows of $52.81.

items.title: Can silver price hit ₹2.84 lakh/kg as rates in free fall ahead of 2026 Dhanteras, Diwali? Levels, target, stop loss
items.summary: MCX silver fell more than 2% to about ₹1,91,516 per kg on Tuesday as a stronger dollar, Fed uncertainty and oil-linked inflation worries weighed, with spot silver down 2.1% to $52.77 an ounce. Analysts cited in the piece put key MCX support near ₹1.90 lakh and resistance near ₹2.02 lakh, and a longer-term view cited for the second half of 2027 puts silver at $75–$80 an ounce.

items.title: Dhanteras 2026: NSE's Electronic Gold Receipts trading crosses ₹93 crore; What investors should know about costs and liquidity
items.summary: NSE Electronic Gold Receipts have recorded cumulative traded value of about ₹93.30 crore, with over 5,900 units traded by Oct 16, 2026, per NSE's October 2026 Market Pulse report cited by Upstox. EGRs, launched in May 2026, give ownership of physical gold held in SEBI-accredited vaults and trade electronically. Turnover alone does not show how easily investors can buy or sell at good prices.

items.title: Rs 1 Lakh For Dhanteras Gold: How Much Gold Do You Actually Take Home?
items.summary: At around ₹14,000 per gram, ₹1 lakh buys 6.93 grams as coins or bars once 3% GST takes the per-gram cost to ₹14,420, the piece calculates. As jewellery, 5% making charges plus GST take the per-gram cost to ₹15,141, so the same ₹1 lakh buys about 6.60 grams.

items.title: Dhanteras, Diwali 2026: 4 factors that could affect gold prices after US midterm elections, according to WGC
items.summary: The World Gold Council examines how the US midterm elections could affect gold, Upstox reports: a Democratic-controlled Congress could make policymaking less predictable, pushing the administration toward wider use of executive orders, which the Council's Juan Carlos Artigas says could raise risk premia and support gold. Indian seasonal demand is gathering pace as retailers restock.

items.title: What are different ways to invest in gold this Dhanteras?
items.summary: Indian households buying gold for Dhanteras and Diwali can choose physical gold, gold ETFs, gold mutual funds, digital gold or electronic gold receipts, with sovereign gold bonds another route. Each form differs on storage, liquidity and cost, so the right choice depends on whether the metal is for wearing, gifting or investing.

BIS has extended mandatory hallmarking of gold jewellery to 12 more districts under the Third Amendment Order, 2026, issued on August 3, The Retail Jeweller India reports. Coverage rises from 380 to 392 districts across 26 states and union territories, including Kancheepuram, Panipat, Angul and Jhargram — a purity check for festive jewellery buyers.
items.title: BIS expands mandatory hallmarkingof gold jewellery to 12 more districts
RBI sets early redemption price for Sovereign Gold Bond 2020-21 Series I
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has set the early redemption price for Sovereign Gold Bond 2020-21 Series I at ₹14,159 per unit for the October 28, 2026 redemption date. The price is the simple average of IBJA closing prices for 999-purity gold over October 23, 26 and 27. Holders can redeem early on the interest payment date after the fifth year from issue.
